articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.rating_consensus: A sweeping IMAX 70mm epic that critics hail as the kind of movie Hollywood rarely makes anymore. Ludwig Göransson's pulse-pounding score is the standout, Nolan's mythic vision earns near-universal praise — docked only for stretches where spectacle alone can't sustain the nearly three-hour momentum.
